info.name: Oracle GoldenGate REST API
info.description:
RESTful API for managing Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture, including deployment configuration, extract and replicat process management, credentials, database connections, distribution and receiver services, performance metrics, and monitoring. Based on Oracle GoldenGate 21c Microservices Architecture REST API documentation.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
